title: Maestro MCP v3 Tool Catalog
description: Authoritative catalog for the Maestro MCP tools. Principal and resource scope are derived from the authenticated server context. Version 3.2 extended the frozen 3.1 catalog with the W4.5 work-graph and asset-ledger surfaces (worktree_graph_query, decomposition_propose, asset_register, asset_review, asset_approve, asset_query); version 3.3 re-maps those six tools onto the asset.*/workgraph.* permission families and the developer-level propose/register grants (M4 J4 slice, CR-1). Changes require a contract change request through the integration session.

tools.name: decomposition_propose
tools.description: Submit one DecompositionProposal batch to the plan's draft revision behind the graph CAS. Developer-level write (developer and coordinator sessions); the server validates scope/cycle/budget/resource and decides applied/rejected with stable violation codes.

tools.name: asset_register
tools.description: Register one asset version into the ledger (digest+pointer mode). Machine checks: frozen type catalog, digest format, sensitivity rules, supersedes chain, confidential pointer-only; the server derives the version and owner. Multi-sign floor (W5-2): release-note assets always require product_owner+technical_lead signoffs.

summary.description: Optional summary: one JSON document serialized as a string. Non-JSON or over-long values are rejected as INVALID_PARAMETER before the store (W5-4).

required_approver_roles.description: Functional roles whose distinct signoffs release this version (W5-2 multi-sign gate). The release-note type always requires product_owner+technical_lead server-side; declaring roles can only add to that floor.

tools.name: asset_review
tools.description: Record the review pass of one asset version (draft to reviewed). Functional review plane (technical_lead, qa_owner); the reviewer may not be the registering owner.

tools.name: asset_approve
tools.description: Approve one reviewed asset version (reviewed to approved; the superseded predecessor and stale gate bindings flip in the same transaction). Functional release plane; delegated principals are vetoed. Multi-sign (W5-2): with required approver roles each call records the caller's functional signoff and the flip lands only after every required role signed.

tools.name: asset_query
tools.description: Query the asset ledger: filter by asset identity (full version chain), type, sensitivity or lifecycle status.
